sources.snippet: VAETKI is a large language model collaboratively developed by the NC-AI consortium, involving 13 organizations and led by NC-AI. Its primary design goals are efficiency and scalability, achieved through the adoption of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. sources.title: NC AI Unveils 'VAETKI,' a Scalable Multimodal Foundation Model to ...
sources.snippet: NC AI on January 8 unveiled VAETKI (Vertical AI Engine for Transformation of Key Industries), a scalable multimodal generative foundation model designed to accelerate AI transformation (AX) across South Korea's core industries. VAETKI is the outcome of the Ministry of Science and ICT's sovereign AI foundation model initiative.
